import primitive_api as api

# Task context and initial state
ctx = api.get_task_context()
print("goal:", ctx.get("goal"))
print("scene:", ctx.get("scene"))
print("instructions:", ctx.get("steps") or ctx.get("instructions"))

frame0 = api.get_frame(label="initial")
print("initial_frame:", frame0.get("path") if isinstance(frame0, dict) else frame0)

obs = api.observe()
print("pose:", obs.get("agent") or obs.get("pose"))
print("inventory:", obs.get("inventory"))

visible = obs.get("visible_objects") or obs.get("objects") or []
print("visible_count:", len(visible))
print("visible:", [v.get("objectId") for v in visible[:20] if isinstance(v, dict)])

# Bounded in-place scan for target object and relevant receptacles/fixtures
queries = [
    "SoapBar",
    "Soap",
    "Sink",
    "SinkBasin",
    "Faucet",
    "Bathtub",
    "BathtubBasin",
    "Tub",
]

scan = api.scan_scene(
    queries=queries,
    rotations=4,
    include_tilts=True,
    remember=True,
)

hits = scan.get("query_hits", {})
if isinstance(hits, dict):
    for q in queries:
        items = hits.get(q, [])
        ids = []
        for item in items[:6]:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                ids.append(item.get("objectId") or item.get("name") or item.get("objectType"))
            else:
                ids.append(str(item))
        print("hit", q, ids)
else:
    print("query_hits raw:", str(hits)[:500])

seen_types = sorted({
    (o.get("objectType") or o.get("type") or "?")
    for o in (scan.get("all_seen") or [])
    if isinstance(o, dict)
})
print("seen_types:", seen_types)
print("memory_count:", scan.get("memory_count"))

# Capture post-scan visual evidence for the next turn
view = api.inspect_current_view(label="post_scan", remember=True)
post_visible = view.get("visible_objects") or []
print("post_scan_visible:", [v.get("objectId") for v in post_visible[:20] if isinstance(v, dict)])
print("post_scan_frame:", view.get("frame"))

prog = api.check_progress_public()
print("progress_summary:", {
    k: prog.get(k)
    for k in ("progress", "success", "steps", "step_usage", "inventory", "visible_count", "memory_count")
})

steps.title: recall visible objects · approach object · look
steps.code:
import primitive_api as api

# Recall layout from memory to understand the scene
mem = api.recall_visible_objects(limit=60)
layout = {}
for o in mem:
    t = o.get("objectType")
    layout.setdefault(t, []).append((o.get("objectId"), o.get("position")))
for t in sorted(layout):
    print(t, layout[t])

soaps = api.recall_visible_objects(query="SoapBar")
print("soap memories:", [(s.get("objectId"), s.get("position")) for s in soaps])

def hgt(s):
    p = s.get("position") or {}
    return p.get("y", 0.0)

soap_high = max(soaps, key=hgt)   # counter-height candidate (near a sink)
soap_low  = min(soaps, key=hgt)   # low candidate

# Approach the counter-height soap and look at it
r1 = api.approach_object(soap_high, max_steps=5, stop_distance=0.7)
print("approach high soap final_distance:", r1.get("final_distance"))
api.look("down")
v1 = api.inspect_current_view(label="near_soap_high", remember=True)
print("visible near high soap:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), round(o.get("distance", 9), 2)) for o in v1.get("visible_objects", [])])
f1 = api.get_frame(label="soap_high_view")
print("frame1:", f1.get("path"))
print("faucets here:", [(o.get("objectId"), o.get("toggleable")) for o in api.detect_objects("Faucet")])
print("basins here:", [o.get("objectId") for o in api.detect_objects("SinkBasin")])

# Approach the low soap and look at it
r2 = api.approach_object(soap_low, max_steps=6, stop_distance=0.7)
print("approach low soap final_distance:", r2.get("final_distance"))
api.look("down")
v2 = api.inspect_current_view(label="near_soap_low", remember=True)
print("visible near low soap:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), round(o.get("distance", 9), 2)) for o in v2.get("visible_objects", [])])
f2 = api.get_frame(label="soap_low_view")
print("frame2:", f2.get("path"))

prog = api.check_progress_public()
print("progress:", prog.get("progress"), "success:", prog.get("success"), "inventory:", prog.get("inventory"))

import primitive_api as api

soap_id = "SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34"     # pink bar on counter by the sink
basin_id = "Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25|SinkBasin"

# 1) pick the pink bar
pu = api.pickup_object(soap_id)
print("pickup ok:", getattr(pu, "success", pu))
print("inventory:", [o.get("objectId") for o in api.query_inventory()])

# 2) put it into the sink basin
put = api.put_object(soap_id, basin_id)
print("put ok:", getattr(put, "success", put))
print("inventory after put:", [o.get("objectId") for o in api.query_inventory()])

# 3) find the faucet around the sink
api.look("up")
det = api.detect_objects("Faucet")
print("faucet after look up:", [o.get("objectId") for o in det])
if not det:
    api.look("up")
    det = api.detect_objects("Faucet")
    print("faucet after 2x up:", [o.get("objectId") for o in det])
if not det:
    api.rotate("left")
    det = api.detect_objects("Faucet")
    print("faucet after rot left:", [o.get("objectId") for o in det])
    if not det:
        api.rotate("right"); api.rotate("right")
        det = api.detect_objects("Faucet")
        print("faucet after rot right x2:", [o.get("objectId") for o in det])
fr = api.get_frame(label="faucet_search")
print("frame:", fr.get("path"))
print("visible now:", [(o.get("objectType"), round(o.get("distance", 9), 2)) for o in api.detect_objects()])

# 4) wash: toggle faucet on/off while bar sits in basin
if det:
    fau = det[0].get("objectId")
    t1 = api.toggle_object(fau, on=True)
    print("toggle on:", getattr(t1, "success", t1))
    t2 = api.toggle_object(fau, on=False)
    print("toggle off:", getattr(t2, "success", t2))
    api.look("down"); api.look("down")
    st = api.query_object_state(soap_id)
    print("soap state:", {k: st.get(k) for k in ("isClean", "isDirty", "parentReceptacles", "visible")} if isinstance(st, dict) else st)
else:
    print("NO FAUCET FOUND")

prog = api.check_progress_public()
print("progress:", prog.get("progress"), "success:", prog.get("success"))

basin  = "Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25|SinkBasin"
faucet = "Faucet|-02.54|+00.79|+00.11"

    if isinstance(r, dict):
        oa = r.get("observation_after") or {}
        return {"success": r.get("success"),
                "last": r.get("lastActionSuccess", oa.get("lastActionSuccess")),
                "err": (r.get("errorMessage") or oa.get("errorMessage") or "")[:80]}
    return r

def vis_ids():
    return [o.get("objectId") for o in api.detect_objects()]

inv = api.query_inventory()
print("inv:", [o.get("objectId") for o in inv])

ids = vis_ids()
print("basin visible:", basin in ids, "| faucet visible:", faucet in ids)
if basin not in ids:
    api.look("down"); ids = vis_ids()
    print("after look down -> basin visible:", basin in ids)

# 1) put held bar into sink basin
if inv:
    p = api.put_object(soap, basin)
    print("put:", brief(p))
st = api.query_object_state(soap)
print("soap parents:", st.get("parentReceptacles"), "clean:", st.get("isClean"), "held:", st.get("isPickedUp"))

if not (st.get("parentReceptacles") or []) or basin not in (st.get("parentReceptacles") or []):

steps.title: The episode reaches its success condition.
steps.code:
import primitive_api as api

soap   = "SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34"
basin  = "Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25|SinkBasin"
faucet = "Faucet|-02.54|+00.79|+00.11"
tubbas = "Bathtub|-03.59|+00.11|+01.52|BathtubBasin"

def ids():
    return {o.get("objectId") for o in api.detect_objects()}

def ok(r):
    if isinstance(r, dict):
        oa = r.get("observation_after") or {}
        return bool(r.get("lastActionSuccess", oa.get("lastActionSuccess")))
    return bool(getattr(r, "success", False))

def parents():
    st = api.query_object_state(soap)
    return st.get("parentReceptacles") if isinstance(st, dict) else None

cur = ids()
print("start visible soap/basin/faucet/tubbas:",
      soap in cur, basin in cur, faucet in cur, tubbas in cur)

# 1) re-pickup the bar from the tub rim
if soap in cur:
    print("pickup:", ok(api.pickup_object(soap)))
else:
    print("soap not visible!", parents())
print("inv:", [o.get("objectId") for o in api.query_inventory()])

# 2) put it back in the sink basin and wash properly
cur = ids()
if basin not in cur:
    api.look("down"); cur = ids()
print("basin visible:", basin in cur)
print("put basin:", ok(api.put_object(soap, basin)), "parents:", parents())

# 3) faucet on -> off
cur = ids()
if faucet not in cur:
    api.look("up"); cur = ids()
print("faucet visible:", faucet in cur)
print("faucet on:", ok(api.toggle_object(faucet, on=True)))
print("faucet off:", ok(api.toggle_object(faucet, on=False)))

# 4) pickup washed bar
api.look("down")
cur = ids()
print("soap visible for repickup:", soap in cur)
print("repickup:", ok(api.pickup_object(soap)))
print("inv:", [o.get("objectId") for o in api.query_inventory()])

# 5) place into the bathtub BASIN (not the rim)
cur = ids()
if tubbas not in cur:
    api.look("up"); cur = ids()
if tubbas not in cur:
    api.rotate("right"); cur = ids()
print("tubbasin visible:", tubbas in cur)
print("put tubbasin:", ok(api.put_object(soap, tubbas)), "parents:", parents())

cs = api.check_success()
print("check_success:", cs)
